texts.NIV84: O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple, they have reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
texts.KJV: O god, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
texts.DRB: A psalm for Asaph. O God, the heathens are come into thy inheritance, they have defiled thy holy temple: they have made Jerusalem as a place to keep fruit.

texts.NIV84: They have given the dead bodies of your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of your saints to the beasts of the earth.
texts.KJV: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
texts.NASB95:
They have given the dead bodies of Your servants for food to the birds of the heavens,
The flesh of Your godly ones to the beasts of the earth.
texts.NKJV:
The dead bodies of Your servants
They have given as food for the birds of the heavens,
The flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.
texts.DRB: They have given the dead bodies of thy servants to be meat for the fowls of the air: the flesh of thy saints for the beasts of the earth.
texts.ESV:
They have given the bodies of your servants
    to the birds of the heavens for food,
    the flesh of your faithful to the beasts of the earth.

texts.NIV84: They have poured out blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.
texts.KJV: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
texts.NASB95:
They have poured out their blood like water round about Jerusalem;
And there was no one to bury them.
texts.NKJV:
Their blood they have shed like water all around Jerusalem,
And there was no one to bury them.
texts.DRB: They have poured out their blood as water, round about Jerusalem and there was none to bury them.
texts.ESV:
They have poured out their blood like water
    all around Jerusalem,
    and there was no one to bury them.

texts.NIV84: We are objects of reproach to our neighbors, of scorn and derision to those around us.
texts.KJV: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
texts.NASB95:
We have become a reproach to our neighbors,
A scoffing and derision to those around us.
texts.NKJV:
We have become a reproach to our neighbors,
A scorn and derision to those who are around us.
texts.DRB: We are become a reproach to our neighbours: a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
texts.ESV:
We have become a taunt to our neighbors,
    mocked and derided by those around us.

texts.NIV84: How long, O LORD? Will you be angry forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?
texts.KJV: How long, Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
texts.NASB95:
How long, O Lord? Will You be angry forever?
Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
texts.NKJV:
How long, Lord?
Will You be angry forever?
Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
texts.DRB: How long, O Lord, wilt thou be angry for ever: shall thy zeal be kindled like a fire?
texts.ESV:
How long, O Lord? Will you be angry forever?
    Will your jealousy burn like fire?

texts.NIV84: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name;
texts.KJV: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
texts.NASB95:
Pour out Your wrath upon the nations which do not know You,
And upon the kingdoms which do not call upon Your name.
texts.NKJV:
Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not know You,
And on the kingdoms that do not call on Your name.
texts.DRB: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that have not known thee: and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
texts.ESV:
Pour out your anger on the nations
    that do not know you,
and on the kingdoms
    that do not call upon your name!

texts.NIV84: for they have devoured Jacob and destroyed his homeland.
texts.KJV: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
texts.NASB95:
For they have devoured Jacob
And laid waste his habitation.
texts.NKJV:
For they have devoured Jacob,
And laid waste his dwelling place.
texts.DRB: Because they have devoured Jacob; and have laid waste his place.
texts.ESV:
For they have devoured Jacob
    and laid waste his habitation.

texts.NIV84: Do not hold against us the sins of the fathers; may your mercy come quickly to meet us, for we are in desperate need.
texts.KJV: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
texts.NKJV:
Oh, do not remember former iniquities against us!
Let Your tender mercies come speedily to meet us,
For we have been brought very low.
texts.DRB: Remember not our former iniquities: let thy mercies speedily prevent us, for we are become exceeding poor.

texts.NIV84: Help us, O God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name's sake.
texts.KJV: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
texts.NASB95:
Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name;
And deliver us and forgive our sins for Your name’s sake.
texts.NKJV:
Help us, O God of our salvation,
For the glory of Your name;
And deliver us, and provide atonement for our sins,
For Your name’s sake!
texts.DRB: Help us, O God, our saviour: and for the glory of thy name, O Lord, deliver us: and forgive us our sins for thy name's sake:
texts.ESV:
Help us, O God of our salvation,
    for the glory of your name;
deliver us, and atone for our sins,
    for your name's sake!

texts.NIV84: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Before our eyes, make known among the nations that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.
texts.KJV: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
texts.NASB95:
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
Let there be known among the nations in our sight,
Vengeance for the blood of Your servants which has been shed.
texts.NKJV:
Why should the nations say,
“Where is their God?”
Let there be known among the nations in our sight
The avenging of the blood of Your servants which has been shed.
texts.DRB: Lest they should say among the Gentiles: Where is their God? And let him be made known among the nations before our eyes, By the revenging the blood of thy servants, which hath been shed:
texts.ESV:
Why should the nations say,
    “Where is their God?”
Let the avenging of the outpoured blood of your servants
    be known among the nations before our eyes!

texts.NIV84: May the groans of the prisoners come before you; by the strength of your arm preserve those condemned to die.
texts.KJV: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
texts.NASB95:
Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You;
According to the greatness of Your power preserve those who are doomed to die.
texts.DRB: let the sighing of the prisoners come in before thee. According to the greatness of thy arm, take possession of the children of them that have been put to death.
texts.ESV:
Let the groans of the prisoners come before you;
    according to your great power, preserve those doomed to die!

texts.NIV84: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the reproach they have hurled at you, O Lord.
texts.KJV: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
texts.NASB95:
And return to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom
The reproach with which they have reproached You, O Lord.
texts.NKJV:
And return to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom
Their reproach with which they have reproached You, O Lord.
texts.DRB: And render to our neighbours sevenfold in their bosom: the reproach wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
texts.ESV:
Return sevenfold into the lap of our neighbors
    the taunts with which they have taunted you, O Lord!

texts.NIV84: Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will praise you forever; from generation to generation we will recount your praise.
texts.KJV: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
texts.DRB: But we thy people, and the sheep of thy pasture, will give thanks to thee for ever. We will shew forth thy praise, unto generation and generation.

texts.NIV84: Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock; you who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
texts.KJV: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, for them that shall he changed, a testimony for Asaph, a psalm. Give ear, O thou that rulest Israel: thou that leadest Joseph like a sheep. Thou that sittest upon the cherubims, shine forth
texts.ESV:
Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel,
    you who lead Joseph like a flock.
You who are enthroned upon the cherubim, shine forth.

texts.NIV84: before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh. Awaken your might; come and save us.
texts.KJV: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
texts.NASB95:
Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up Your power
And come to save us!
texts.NKJV:
Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh,
Stir up Your strength,
And come and save us!
texts.DRB: before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasses. Stir up thy might, and come to save us.
texts.ESV:
Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh,
stir up your might
    and come to save us!

texts.NIV84: Restore us, O God; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.
texts.KJV: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
texts.NASB95:
O God, restore us
And cause Your face to shine upon us, and we will be saved.
texts.DRB: Convert us, O God: and shew us thy face, and we shall be saved.
texts.ESV:
Restore us, O God;
    let your face shine, that we may be saved!

texts.NIV84: O LORD God Almighty, how long will your anger smolder against the prayers of your people?
texts.KJV: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
texts.NASB95:
O Lord God of hosts,
How long will You be angry with the prayer of Your people?
texts.NKJV:
O Lord God of hosts,
How long will You be angry
Against the prayer of Your people?
texts.DRB: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy servant?
texts.ESV:
O Lord God of hosts,
    how long will you be angry with your people's prayers?

texts.NIV84: You have fed them with the bread of tears; you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.
texts.KJV: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
texts.NASB95:
You have fed them with the bread of tears,
And You have made them to drink tears in large measure.
texts.NKJV:
You have fed them with the bread of tears,
And given them tears to drink in great measure.
texts.DRB: How long wilt thou feed us with the bread of tears: and give us for our drink tears in measure?
texts.ESV:
You have fed them with the bread of tears
    and given them tears to drink in full measure.

texts.NIV84: You have made us a source of contention to our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.
texts.KJV: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
texts.NASB95:
You make us an object of contention to our neighbors,
And our enemies laugh among themselves.
texts.NKJV:
You have made us a strife to our neighbors,
And our enemies laugh among themselves.
texts.DRB: Thou hast made us to be a contradiction to our neighbours: and our enemies have scoffed at us.
texts.ESV:
You make us an object of contention for our neighbors,
    and our enemies laugh among themselves.

texts.NIV84: Restore us, O God Almighty; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.
texts.KJV: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
texts.NASB95:
O God of hosts, restore us
And cause Your face to shine upon us, and we will be saved.
texts.DRB: O God of hosts, convert us: and shew thy face, and we shall be saved.
texts.ESV:
Restore us, O God of hosts;
    let your face shine, that we may be saved!

texts.NIV84: You brought a vine out of Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.
texts.KJV: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
texts.NASB95:
You removed a vine from Egypt;
You drove out the nations and planted it.
texts.NKJV:
You have brought a vine out of Egypt;
You have cast out the nations, and planted it.
texts.DRB: Thou hast brought a vineyard out of Egypt: thou hast cast cut the Gentiles and planted it.
texts.ESV:
You brought a vine out of Egypt;
    you drove out the nations and planted it.

texts.NIV84: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.
texts.KJV: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
texts.NASB95:
You cleared the ground before it,
And it took deep root and filled the land.
texts.NKJV:
You prepared room for it,
And caused it to take deep root,
And it filled the land.
texts.DRB: Thou wast the guide of its journey in its sight: thou plantedst the roots thereof, and it filled the land.
texts.ESV:
You cleared the ground for it;
    it took deep root and filled the land.

texts.NIV84: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.
texts.KJV: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
texts.NASB95:
The mountains were covered with its shadow,
And the cedars of God with its boughs.
texts.NKJV:
The hills were covered with its shadow,
And the mighty cedars with its boughs.
texts.DRB: The shadow of it covered the hills: and the branches thereof the cedars of God.
texts.ESV:
The mountains were covered with its shade,
    the mighty cedars with its branches.

texts.NIV84: It sent out its boughs to the Sea, its shoots as far as the River.
texts.KJV: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
texts.NASB95:
It was sending out its branches to the sea
And its shoots to the River.
texts.NKJV:
She sent out her boughs to the Sea,
And her branches to the River.
texts.DRB: It stretched forth its branches unto the sea, and its boughs unto the river.
texts.ESV:
It sent out its branches to the sea
    and its shoots to the River.

texts.NIV84: Why have you broken down its walls so that all who pass by pick its grapes?
texts.KJV: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
texts.NASB95:
Why have You broken down its hedges,
So that all who pass that way pick its fruit?
texts.NKJV:
Why have You broken down her hedges,
So that all who pass by the way pluck her fruit?
texts.DRB: Why hast thou broken down the hedge thereof, so that all they who pass by the way do pluck it?
texts.ESV:
Why then have you broken down its walls,
    so that all who pass along the way pluck its fruit?

texts.NIV84: Boars from the forest ravage it and the creatures of the field feed on it.
texts.KJV: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
texts.NASB95:
A boar from the forest eats it away
And whatever moves in the field feeds on it.
texts.NKJV:
The boar out of the woods uproots it,
And the wild beast of the field devours it.
texts.DRB: The boar out of the wood hath laid it waste: and a singular wild beast hath devoured it.
texts.ESV:
The boar from the forest ravages it,
    and all that move in the field feed on it.

texts.NIV84: Return to us, O God Almighty! Look down from heaven and see! Watch over this vine,
texts.KJV: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
texts.NASB95:
O God of hosts, turn again now, we beseech You;
Look down from heaven and see, and take care of this vine,
texts.DRB: Turn again, O God of hosts, look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vineyard:

texts.NIV84: the root your right hand has planted, the son you have raised up for yourself.
texts.KJV: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
texts.NASB95:
Even the shoot which Your right hand has planted,
And on the son whom You have strengthened for Yourself.
texts.NKJV:
And the vineyard which Your right hand has planted,
And the branch that You made strong for Yourself.
texts.DRB: And perfect the same which thy right hand hath planted: and upon the son of man whom thou hast confirmed for thyself.
texts.ESV:
the stock that your right hand planted,
    and for the son whom you made strong for yourself.

texts.NIV84: Your vine is cut down, it is burned with fire; at your rebuke your people perish.
texts.KJV: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
texts.NASB95:
It is burned with fire, it is cut down;
They perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
texts.NKJV:
It is burned with fire, it is cut down;
They perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
texts.DRB: Things set on fire and dug down shall perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
texts.ESV:
They have burned it with fire; they have cut it down;
    may they perish at the rebuke of your face!

texts.NIV84: Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself.
texts.KJV: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
texts.NASB95:
Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand,
Upon the son of man whom You made strong for Yourself.
texts.NKJV:
Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand,
Upon the son of man whom You made strong for Yourself.
texts.DRB: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand: and upon the son of man whom thou hast confirmed for thyself.
texts.ESV:
But let your hand be on the man of your right hand,
    the son of man whom you have made strong for yourself!

texts.NIV84: Then we will not turn away from you; revive us, and we will call on your name.
texts.KJV: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
texts.NASB95:
Then we shall not turn back from You;
Revive us, and we will call upon Your name.
texts.NKJV:
Then we will not turn back from You;
Revive us, and we will call upon Your name.
texts.DRB: And we depart not from thee, thou shalt quicken us: and we will call upon thy name.
texts.ESV:
Then we shall not turn back from you;
    give us life, and we will call upon your name!

texts.NIV84: Restore us, O LORD God Almighty; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.
texts.KJV: Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord God of hosts, restore us;
Cause Your face to shine upon us, and we will be saved.
texts.DRB: O Lord God of hosts, convert us: and shew thy face, and we shall be saved.
texts.ESV:
Restore us, O Lord God of hosts!
    Let your face shine, that we may be saved!

texts.NIV84: O God, do not keep silent; be not quiet, O God, be not still.
texts.KJV: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
texts.NASB95:
O God, do not remain quiet;
Do not be silent and, O God, do not be still.
texts.NKJV:
Do not keep silent, O God!
Do not hold Your peace,
And do not be still, O God!
texts.DRB: A canticle of a psalm for Asaph. O God, who shall be like to thee? hold not thy peace, neither be thou still, O God.
texts.ESV:
O God, do not keep silence;
    do not hold your peace or be still, O God!

texts.NIV84: See how your enemies are astir, how your foes rear their heads.
texts.KJV: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
texts.NASB95:
For behold, Your enemies make an uproar,
And those who hate You have exalted themselves.
texts.NKJV:
For behold, Your enemies make a tumult;
And those who hate You have lifted up their head.
texts.DRB: For lo, thy enemies have made a noise: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
texts.ESV:
For behold, your enemies make an uproar;
    those who hate you have raised their heads.

texts.NIV84: With cunning they conspire against your people; they plot against those you cherish.
texts.KJV: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
texts.NASB95:
They make shrewd plans against Your people,
And conspire together against Your treasured ones.
texts.NKJV:
They have taken crafty counsel against Your people,
And consulted together against Your sheltered ones.
texts.DRB: They have taken a malicious counsel against thy people, and have consulted against thy saints.
texts.ESV:
They lay crafty plans against your people;
    they consult together against your treasured ones.

texts.NIV84: "Come," they say, "let us destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel be remembered no more."
texts.KJV: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
texts.NASB95:
They have said, “Come, and let us wipe them out as a nation,
That the name of Israel be remembered no more.”
texts.NKJV:
They have said, “Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation,
That the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
texts.DRB: They have said: Come and let us destroy them, so that they be not a nation: and let the name of Israel be remembered no more.
texts.ESV:
They say, “Come, let us wipe them out as a nation;
    let the name of Israel be remembered no more!”

texts.NIV84: With one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against you-
texts.KJV: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
texts.NASB95:
For they have conspired together with one mind;
Against You they make a covenant:
texts.NKJV:
For they have consulted together with one consent;
They form a confederacy against You:
texts.DRB: For they have contrived with one consent: they have made a covenant together against thee,
texts.ESV:
For they conspire with one accord;
    against you they make a covenant—

texts.NIV84: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
texts.KJV: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
texts.NASB95:
The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites,
Moab and the Hagrites;
texts.NKJV:
The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites;
Moab and the Hagrites;
texts.DRB: the tabernacles of the Edomites, and the Ismahelites: Moab, and the Agarens,
texts.ESV:
the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites,
    Moab and the Hagrites,

texts.NIV84: Gebal, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the people of Tyre.
texts.KJV: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
texts.NASB95:
Gebal and Ammon and Amalek,
Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
texts.NKJV:
Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek;
Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
texts.DRB: Gebal, and Ammon and Amalec: the Philistines, with the inhabitants of Tyre.
texts.ESV:
Gebal and Ammon and Amalek,
    Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

texts.NIV84: Even Assyria has joined them to lend strength to the descendants of Lot. Selah
texts.KJV: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
texts.NASB95:
Assyria also has joined with them;
They have become a help to the children of Lot. Selah.
texts.NKJV:
Assyria also has joined with them;
They have helped the children of Lot. Selah
texts.DRB: Yea, and the Assyrian also is joined with them: they are come to the aid of the sons of Lot.
texts.ESV:
Asshur also has joined them;
    they are the strong arm of the children of Lot. Selah

texts.NIV84: Do to them as you did to Midian, as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,
texts.KJV: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
texts.NASB95:
Deal with them as with Midian,
As with Sisera and Jabin at the torrent of Kishon,
texts.NKJV:
Deal with them as with Midian,
As with Sisera,
As with Jabin at the Brook Kishon,
texts.DRB: Do to them as thou didst to Madian and to Sisara: as to Jabin at the brook of Cisson.
texts.ESV:
Do to them as you did to Midian,
    as to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,

texts.NIV84: who perished at Endor and became like refuse on the ground.
texts.KJV: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
texts.NASB95:
Who were destroyed at En-dor,
Who became as dung for the ground.
texts.NKJV:
Who perished at En Dor,
Who became as refuse on the earth.
texts.DRB: Who perished at Endor: and became as dung for the earth.
texts.ESV:
who were destroyed at En-dor,
    who became dung for the ground.

texts.NIV84: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
texts.KJV: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
texts.NASB95:
Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb
And all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
texts.NKJV:
Make their nobles like Oreb and like Zeeb,
Yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
texts.DRB: Make their princes like Oreb, and Zeb, and Zebee, and Salmana. All their princes,
texts.ESV:
Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb,
    all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

texts.NIV84: who said, "Let us take possession of the pasturelands of God."
texts.KJV: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
texts.NASB95:
Who said, “Let us possess for ourselves
The pastures of God.”
texts.NKJV:
Who said, “Let us take for ourselves
The pastures of God for a possession.”
texts.DRB: who have said: Let us possess the sanctuary of God for an inheritance.
texts.ESV:
who said, “Let us take possession for ourselves
    of the pastures of God.”

texts.NIV84: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.
texts.KJV: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
texts.NASB95:
O my God, make them like the whirling dust,
Like chaff before the wind.
texts.NKJV:
O my God, make them like the whirling dust,
Like the chaff before the wind!
texts.DRB: O my God, make them like a wheel; and as stubble before the wind.
texts.ESV:
O my God, make them like whirling dust,
    like chaff before the wind.

texts.NIV84: As fire consumes the forest or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
texts.KJV: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
texts.NASB95:
Like fire that burns the forest
And like a flame that sets the mountains on fire,
texts.NKJV:
As the fire burns the woods,
And as the flame sets the mountains on fire,
texts.DRB: As fire which burneth the wood: and as a flame burning mountains:
texts.ESV:
As fire consumes the forest,
    as the flame sets the mountains ablaze,

texts.NIV84: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your storm.
texts.KJV: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
texts.NASB95:
So pursue them with Your tempest
And terrify them with Your storm.
texts.NKJV:
So pursue them with Your tempest,
And frighten them with Your storm.
texts.DRB: So shalt thou pursue them with thy tempest: and shalt trouble them in thy wrath.
texts.ESV:
so may you pursue them with your tempest
    and terrify them with your hurricane!

texts.NIV84: Cover their faces with shame so that men will seek your name, O LORD.
texts.KJV: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.
texts.NASB95:
Fill their faces with dishonor,
That they may seek Your name, O Lord.
texts.NKJV:
Fill their faces with shame,
That they may seek Your name, O Lord.
texts.DRB: Fill their faces with shame; and they shall seek thy name, O Lord.
texts.ESV:
Fill their faces with shame,
    that they may seek your name, O Lord.

texts.NIV84: May they ever be ashamed and dismayed; may they perish in disgrace.
texts.KJV: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
texts.NASB95:
Let them be ashamed and dismayed forever,
And let them be humiliated and perish,
texts.NKJV:
Let them be confounded and dismayed forever;
Yes, let them be put to shame and perish,
texts.DRB: Let them be ashamed and troubled for ever and ever: and let them be confounded and perish.
texts.ESV:
Let them be put to shame and dismayed forever;
    let them perish in disgrace,

texts.NIV84: Let them know that you, whose name is the LORD - that you alone are the Most High over all the earth.
texts.KJV: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is Jehovah, art the most high over all the earth.
texts.NASB95:
That they may know that You alone, whose name is the Lord,
Are the Most High over all the earth.
texts.NKJV:
That they may know that You, whose name alone is the Lord,
Are the Most High over all the earth.
texts.DRB: And let them know that the Lord is thy name: thou alone art the most High over all the earth.
texts.ESV:
that they may know that you alone,
    whose name is the Lord,
    are the Most High over all the earth.

texts.NIV84: You showed favor to your land, O LORD; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.
texts.KJV: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, You showed favor to Your land;
You restored the captivity of Jacob.
texts.NKJV:
Lord, You have been favorable to Your land;
You have brought back the captivity of Jacob.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, for the sons of Core, a psalm. Lord, thou hast blessed thy land: thou hast turned away the captivity of Jacob.
texts.ESV:
Lord, you were favorable to your land;
    you restored the fortunes of Jacob.

texts.NIV84: You forgave the iniquity of your people and covered all their sins. Selah
texts.KJV: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
texts.NASB95:
You forgave the iniquity of Your people;
You covered all their sin. Selah.
texts.NKJV:
You have forgiven the iniquity of Your people;
You have covered all their sin. Selah
texts.DRB: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people: thou hast covered all their sins.
texts.ESV:
You forgave the iniquity of your people;
    you covered all their sin. Selah

texts.NIV84: You set aside all your wrath and turned from your fierce anger.
texts.KJV: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
texts.NASB95:
You withdrew all Your fury;
You turned away from Your burning anger.
texts.NKJV:
You have taken away all Your wrath;
You have turned from the fierceness of Your anger.
texts.DRB: Thou hast mitigated all thy anger: thou best turned away from the wrath of thy indignation.
texts.ESV:
You withdrew all your wrath;
    you turned from your hot anger.

texts.NIV84: Restore us again, O God our Savior, and put away your displeasure toward us.
texts.KJV: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
texts.NASB95:
Restore us, O God of our salvation,
And cause Your indignation toward us to cease.
texts.NKJV:
Restore us, O God of our salvation,
And cause Your anger toward us to cease.
texts.DRB: Convert us, O God our saviour: and turn off thy anger from us.
texts.ESV:
Restore us again, O God of our salvation,
    and put away your indignation toward us!

texts.NIV84: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger through all generations?
texts.KJV: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
texts.NASB95:
Will You be angry with us forever?
Will You prolong Your anger to all generations?
texts.NKJV:
Will You be angry with us forever?
Will You prolong Your anger to all generations?
texts.DRB: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever: or wilt thou extend thy wrath from generation to generation?
texts.ESV:
Will you be angry with us forever?
    Will you prolong your anger to all generations?

texts.NIV84: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
texts.KJV: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
texts.NASB95:
Will You not Yourself revive us again,
That Your people may rejoice in You?
texts.NKJV:
Will You not revive us again,
That Your people may rejoice in You?
texts.DRB: Thou wilt turn, O God, and bring us to life: and thy people shall rejoice in thee.
texts.ESV:
Will you not revive us again,
    that your people may rejoice in you?

texts.NIV84: Show us your unfailing love, O LORD, and grant us your salvation.
texts.KJV: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.
texts.NASB95:
Show us Your lovingkindness, O Lord,
And grant us Your salvation.
texts.NKJV:
Show us Your mercy, Lord,
And grant us Your salvation.
texts.DRB: Shew us, O Lord, thy mercy; and grant us thy salvation.
texts.ESV:
Show us your steadfast love, O Lord,
    and grant us your salvation.

texts.NIV84: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; he promises peace to his people, his saints- but let them not return to folly.
texts.KJV: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
texts.NKJV:
I will hear what God the Lord will speak,
For He will speak peace
To His people and to His saints;
But let them not turn back to folly.
texts.DRB: I will hear what the Lord God will speak in me: for he will speak peace unto his people: And unto his saints: and unto them that are converted to the heart.

texts.NIV84: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.
texts.KJV: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
texts.NASB95:
Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him,
That glory may dwell in our land.
texts.NKJV:
Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him,
That glory may dwell in our land.
texts.DRB: Surely his salvation is near to them that fear him: that glory may dwell in our land.
texts.ESV:
Surely his salvation is near to those who fear him,
    that glory may dwell in our land.

texts.NIV84: Love and faithfulness meet together; righteousness and peace kiss each other.
texts.KJV: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
texts.NASB95:
Lovingkindness and truth have met together;
Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
texts.NKJV:
Mercy and truth have met together;
Righteousness and peace have kissed.
texts.DRB: Mercy and truth have met each other: justice and peace have kissed.
texts.ESV:
Steadfast love and faithfulness meet;
    righteousness and peace kiss each other.

texts.NIV84: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
texts.KJV: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
texts.NASB95:
Truth springs from the earth,
And righteousness looks down from heaven.
texts.NKJV:
Truth shall spring out of the earth,
And righteousness shall look down from heaven.
texts.DRB: Truth is sprung out of the earth: and justice hath looked down from heaven.
texts.ESV:
Faithfulness springs up from the ground,
    and righteousness looks down from the sky.

texts.NIV84: The LORD will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.
texts.KJV: Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
texts.NASB95:
Indeed, the Lord will give what is good,
And our land will yield its produce.
texts.NKJV:
Yes, the Lord will give what is good;
And our land will yield its increase.
texts.DRB: For the Lord will give goodness: and our earth shall yield her fruit.
texts.ESV:
Yes, the Lord will give what is good,
    and our land will yield its increase.

texts.NIV84: Righteousness goes before him and prepares the way for his steps.
texts.KJV: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
texts.NASB95:
Righteousness will go before Him
And will make His footsteps into a way.
texts.NKJV:
Righteousness will go before Him,
And shall make His footsteps our pathway.
texts.DRB: Justice shall walk before him: and shall set his steps in the way.
texts.ESV:
Righteousness will go before him
    and make his footsteps a way.

texts.NIV84: Hear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
texts.KJV: Bow down thine ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
texts.NASB95:
Incline Your ear, O Lord, and answer me;
For I am afflicted and needy.
texts.NKJV:
Bow down Your ear, O Lord, hear me;
For I am poor and needy.
texts.DRB: A prayer for David himself. Incline thy ear, O Lord, and hear me: for I am needy and poor.
texts.ESV:
Incline your ear, O Lord, and answer me,
    for I am poor and needy.

texts.NIV84: Guard my life, for I am devoted to you. You are my God; save your servant who trusts in you.
texts.KJV: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
texts.NASB95:
Preserve my soul, for I am a godly man;
O You my God, save Your servant who trusts in You.
texts.DRB: Preserve my soul, for I am holy: save thy servant, O my God, that trusteth in thee.
texts.ESV:
Preserve my life, for I am godly;
    save your servant, who trusts in you—you are my God.

texts.NIV84: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I call to you all day long.
texts.KJV: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
texts.NASB95:
Be gracious to me, O Lord,
For to You I cry all day long.
texts.NKJV:
Be merciful to me, O Lord,
For I cry to You all day long.
texts.DRB: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I have cried to thee all the day.
texts.ESV:
Be gracious to me, O Lord,
    for to you do I cry all the day.

texts.NIV84: Bring joy to your servant, for to you, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
texts.KJV: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
texts.NASB95:
Make glad the soul of Your servant,
For to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
texts.NKJV:
Rejoice the soul of Your servant,
For to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
texts.DRB: Give joy to the soul of thy servant, for to thee, O Lord, I have lifted up my soul.
texts.ESV:
Gladden the soul of your servant,
    for to you, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

texts.NIV84: You are forgiving and good, O Lord, abounding in love to all who call to you.
texts.KJV: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
texts.NASB95:
For You, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive,
And abundant in lovingkindness to all who call upon You.
texts.NKJV:
For You, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive,
And abundant in mercy to all those who call upon You.
texts.DRB: For thou, O Lord, art sweet and mild: and plenteous in mercy to all that call upon thee.
texts.ESV:
For you, O Lord, are good and forgiving,
    abounding in steadfast love to all who call upon you.

texts.NIV84: Hear my prayer, O LORD; listen to my cry for mercy.
texts.KJV: Give ear, O Lord, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
texts.NASB95:
Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer;
And give heed to the voice of my supplications!
texts.NKJV:
Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer;
And attend to the voice of my supplications.
texts.DRB: Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer: and attend to the voice of my petition.
texts.ESV:
Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer;
    listen to my plea for grace.

texts.NIV84: In the day of my trouble I will call to you, for you will answer me.
texts.KJV: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
texts.NASB95:
In the day of my trouble I shall call upon You,
For You will answer me.
texts.NKJV:
In the day of my trouble I will call upon You,
For You will answer me.
texts.DRB: I have called upon thee in the day of my trouble: because thou hast heard me.
texts.ESV:
In the day of my trouble I call upon you,
    for you answer me.

texts.NIV84: Among the gods there is none like you, O Lord; no deeds can compare with yours.
texts.KJV: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
texts.NASB95:
There is no one like You among the gods, O Lord,
Nor are there any works like Yours.
texts.NKJV:
Among the gods there is none like You, O Lord;
Nor are there any works like Your works.
texts.DRB: There is none among the gods like unto thee, O Lord: and there is none according to thy works.
texts.ESV:
There is none like you among the gods, O Lord,
    nor are there any works like yours.

texts.NIV84: All the nations you have made will come and worship before you, O Lord; they will bring glory to your name.
texts.KJV: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
texts.NASB95:
All nations whom You have made shall come and worship before You, O Lord,
And they shall glorify Your name.
texts.NKJV:
All nations whom You have made
Shall come and worship before You, O Lord,
And shall glorify Your name.
texts.DRB: All the nations thou hast made shall come and adore before thee, O Lord: and they shall glorify thy name.
texts.ESV:
All the nations you have made shall come
    and worship before you, O Lord,
    and shall glorify your name.

texts.NIV84: For you are great and do marvelous deeds; you alone are God.
texts.KJV: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
texts.NASB95:
For You are great and do wondrous deeds;
You alone are God.
texts.NKJV:
For You are great, and do wondrous things;
You alone are God.
texts.DRB: For thou art great and dost wonderful things: thou art God alone.
texts.ESV:
For you are great and do wondrous things;
    you alone are God.

texts.NIV84: Teach me your way, O LORD, and I will walk in your truth; give me an undivided heart, that I may fear your name.
texts.KJV: Teach me thy way, O Lord; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
texts.DRB: Conduct me, O Lord, in thy way, and I will walk in thy truth: let my heart rejoice that it may fear thy name.

texts.NIV84: I will praise you, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify your name forever.
texts.KJV: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
texts.NASB95:
I will give thanks to You, O Lord my God, with all my heart,
And will glorify Your name forever.
texts.NKJV:
I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart,
And I will glorify Your name forevermore.
texts.DRB: I will praise thee, O Lord my God: with my whole heart, and I will glorify thy name for ever:
texts.ESV:
I give thanks to you, O Lord my God, with my whole heart,
    and I will glorify your name forever.

texts.NIV84: For great is your love toward me; you have delivered me from the depths of the grave.
texts.KJV: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
texts.NASB95:
For Your lovingkindness toward me is great,
And You have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.
texts.NKJV:
For great is Your mercy toward me,
And You have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.
texts.DRB: For thy mercy is great towards me: and thou hast delivered my soul out of the lower hell.
texts.ESV:
For great is your steadfast love toward me;
    you have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.

texts.NIV84: The arrogant are attacking me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life- men without regard for you.
texts.KJV: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
texts.NASB95:
O God, arrogant men have risen up against me,
And a band of violent men have sought my life,
And they have not set You before them.
texts.NKJV:
O God, the proud have risen against me,
And a mob of violent men have sought my life,
And have not set You before them.
texts.DRB: O God, the wicked are risen up against me, and the assembly of the mighty have sought my soul: and they have not set thee before their eyes.

texts.NIV84: But you, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.
texts.KJV: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, long suffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
texts.NASB95:
But You, O Lord, are a God merciful and gracious,
Slow to anger and abundant in lovingkindness and truth.
texts.NKJV:
But You, O Lord, are a God full of compassion, and gracious,
Longsuffering and abundant in mercy and truth.
texts.DRB: And thou, O Lord, art a God of compassion, and merciful, patient, and of much mercy, and true.
texts.ESV:
But you, O Lord, are a God merciful and gracious,
    slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness.

texts.NIV84: Turn to me and have mercy on me; grant your strength to your servant and save the son of your maidservant.
texts.KJV: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
texts.NKJV:
Oh, turn to me, and have mercy on me!
Give Your strength to Your servant,
And save the son of Your maidservant.
texts.DRB: O look upon me, and have mercy on me: give thy command to thy servant, and save the son of thy handmaid.

texts.NIV84: Give me a sign of your goodness, that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for you, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
texts.KJV: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, Lord, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
texts.NASB95:
Show me a sign for good,
That those who hate me may see it and be ashamed,
Because You, O Lord, have helped me and comforted me.
texts.NKJV:
Show me a sign for good,
That those who hate me may see it and be ashamed,
Because You, Lord, have helped me and comforted me.
texts.DRB: Shew me a token for good: that they who hate me may see, and be confounded, because thou, O Lord, hast helped me and hast comforted me.
texts.ESV:
Show me a sign of your favor,
    that those who hate me may see and be put to shame
    because you, Lord, have helped me and comforted me.

blocks.title: A Prayer for Help in Despondency

texts.NIV84: O LORD, the God who saves me, day and night I cry out before you.
texts.KJV: O lord God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, the God of my salvation,
I have cried out by day and in the night before You.
texts.NKJV:
O Lord, God of my salvation,
I have cried out day and night before You.
texts.DRB: A canticle of a psalm for the sons of Core: unto the end, for Maheleth, to answer understanding of Eman the Ezrahite. O Lord, the God of my salvation: I have cried in the day, and in the night before thee.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, God of my salvation,
    I cry out day and night before you.

texts.NIV84: May my prayer come before you; turn your ear to my cry.
texts.KJV: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
texts.NASB95:
Let my prayer come before You;
Incline Your ear to my cry!
texts.NKJV:
Let my prayer come before You;
Incline Your ear to my cry.
texts.DRB: Let my prayer come in before thee: incline thy ear to my petition.
texts.ESV:
Let my prayer come before you;
    incline your ear to my cry!

texts.NIV84: For my soul is full of trouble and my life draws near the grave.
texts.KJV: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
texts.NASB95:
For my soul has had enough troubles,
And my life has drawn near to Sheol.
texts.NKJV:
For my soul is full of troubles,
And my life draws near to the grave.
texts.DRB: For my soul is filled with evils: and my life hath drawn nigh to hell.
texts.ESV:
For my soul is full of troubles,
    and my life draws near to Sheol.

texts.NIV84: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am like a man without strength.
texts.KJV: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
texts.NASB95:
I am reckoned among those who go down to the pit;
I have become like a man without strength,
texts.NKJV:
I am counted with those who go down to the pit;
I am like a man who has no strength,
texts.DRB: I am counted among them that go down to the pit: I am become as a man without help,
texts.ESV:
I am counted among those who go down to the pit;
    I am a man who has no strength,

texts.NIV84: I am set apart with the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, who are cut off from your care.
texts.KJV: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
texts.NASB95:
Forsaken among the dead,
Like the slain who lie in the grave,
Whom You remember no more,
And they are cut off from Your hand.
texts.NKJV:
Adrift among the dead,
Like the slain who lie in the grave,
Whom You remember no more,
And who are cut off from Your hand.
texts.DRB: free among the dead. Like the slain sleeping in the sepulchres, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cast off from thy hand.
texts.ESV:
like one set loose among the dead,
    like the slain that lie in the grave,
like those whom you remember no more,
    for they are cut off from your hand.

texts.NIV84: You have put me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
texts.KJV: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
texts.NASB95:
You have put me in the lowest pit,
In dark places, in the depths.
texts.NKJV:
You have laid me in the lowest pit,
In darkness, in the depths.
texts.DRB: They have laid me in the lower pit: in the dark places, and in the shadow of death.
texts.ESV:
You have put me in the depths of the pit,
    in the regions dark and deep.

texts.NIV84: Your wrath lies heavily upon me; you have overwhelmed me with all your waves. Selah
texts.KJV: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
texts.NASB95:
Your wrath has rested upon me,
And You have afflicted me with all Your waves. Selah.
texts.NKJV:
Your wrath lies heavy upon me,
And You have afflicted me with all Your waves. Selah
texts.DRB: Thy wrath is strong over me: and all thy waves thou hast brought in upon me.
texts.ESV:
Your wrath lies heavy upon me,
    and you overwhelm me with all your waves. Selah

texts.NIV84: You have taken from me my closest friends and have made me repulsive to them. I am confined and cannot escape;
texts.KJV: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
texts.DRB: Thou hast put away my acquaintance far from me: they have set me an abomination to themselves. I was delivered up, and came not forth:

texts.NIV84: my eyes are dim with grief. I call to you, O LORD, every day; I spread out my hands to you.
texts.KJV: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
texts.DRB: my eyes languished through poverty. All the day I cried to thee, O Lord: I stretched out my hands to thee.

texts.NIV84: Do you show your wonders to the dead? Do those who are dead rise up and praise you? Selah
texts.KJV: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
texts.NASB95:
Will You perform wonders for the dead?
Will the departed spirits rise and praise You? Selah.
texts.NKJV:
Will You work wonders for the dead?
Shall the dead arise and praise You? Selah
texts.DRB: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? or shall physicians raise to life, and give praise to thee?
texts.ESV:
Do you work wonders for the dead?
    Do the departed rise up to praise you? Selah

texts.NIV84: Is your love declared in the grave, your faithfulness in Destruction?
texts.KJV: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
texts.NASB95:
Will Your lovingkindness be declared in the grave,
Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
texts.NKJV:
Shall Your lovingkindness be declared in the grave?
Or Your faithfulness in the place of destruction?
texts.DRB: Shall any one in the sepulchre declare thy mercy: and thy truth in destruction?
texts.ESV:
Is your steadfast love declared in the grave,
    or your faithfulness in Abaddon?

texts.NIV84: Are your wonders known in the place of darkness, or your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?
texts.KJV: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
texts.NASB95:
Will Your wonders be made known in the darkness?
And Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
texts.NKJV:
Shall Your wonders be known in the dark?
And Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
texts.DRB: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark; and thy justice in the land of forgetfulness?
texts.ESV:
Are your wonders known in the darkness,
    or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

texts.NIV84: But I cry to you for help, O LORD; in the morning my prayer comes before you.
texts.KJV: But unto thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
texts.NASB95:
But I, O Lord, have cried out to You for help,
And in the morning my prayer comes before You.
texts.NKJV:
But to You I have cried out, O Lord,
And in the morning my prayer comes before You.
texts.DRB: But I, O Lord, have cried to thee: and in the morning my prayer shall prevent thee.
texts.ESV:
But I, O Lord, cry to you;
    in the morning my prayer comes before you.

texts.NIV84: Why, O LORD, do you reject me and hide your face from me?
texts.KJV: Lord, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, why do You reject my soul?
Why do You hide Your face from me?
texts.NKJV:
Lord, why do You cast off my soul?
Why do You hide Your face from me?
texts.DRB: Lord, why castest thou off my prayer: why turnest thou away thy face from me?
texts.ESV:
O Lord, why do you cast my soul away?
    Why do you hide your face from me?

texts.NIV84: From my youth I have been afflicted and close to death; I have suffered your terrors and am in despair.
texts.KJV: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
texts.NASB95:
I was afflicted and about to die from my youth on;
I suffer Your terrors; I am overcome.
texts.DRB: I am poor, and in labours from my youth: and being exalted have been humbled and troubled.
texts.ESV:
Afflicted and close to death from my youth up,
    I suffer your terrors; I am helpless.

texts.NIV84: Your wrath has swept over me; your terrors have destroyed me.
texts.KJV: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
texts.NASB95:
Your burning anger has passed over me;
Your terrors have destroyed me.
texts.NKJV:
Your fierce wrath has gone over me;
Your terrors have cut me off.
texts.DRB: Thy wrath hath come upon me: and thy terrors have troubled me.
texts.ESV:
Your wrath has swept over me;
    your dreadful assaults destroy me.

texts.NIV84: All day long they surround me like a flood; they have completely engulfed me.
texts.KJV: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
texts.NASB95:
They have surrounded me like water all day long;
They have encompassed me altogether.
texts.NKJV:
They came around me all day long like water;
They engulfed me altogether.
texts.DRB: They have come round about me like water all the day: they have compassed me about together.
texts.ESV:
They surround me like a flood all day long;
    they close in on me together.

texts.NIV84: You have taken my companions and loved ones from me; the darkness is my closest friend.
texts.KJV: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
texts.NASB95:
You have removed lover and friend far from me;
My acquaintances are in darkness.
texts.NKJV:
Loved one and friend You have put far from me,
And my acquaintances into darkness.
texts.DRB: Friend and neighbour thou hast put far from me: and my acquaintance, because of misery.
texts.ESV:
You have caused my beloved and my friend to shun me;
    my companions have become darkness.

texts.NIV84: Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come to you.
texts.KJV: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come unto thee.
texts.NASB95:
Hear my prayer, O Lord!
And let my cry for help come to You.
texts.NKJV:
Hear my prayer, O Lord,
And let my cry come to You.
texts.DRB: The prayer of the poor man, when he was anxious, and poured out his supplication before the Lord. Hear, O Lord, my prayer: and let my cry come to thee.
texts.ESV:
Hear my prayer, O Lord;
let my cry come to you!

texts.NIV84: Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Turn your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.
texts.KJV: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
texts.DRB: Turn not away thy face from me: in the day when I am in trouble, incline thy ear to me. In what day soever I shall call upon thee, hear me speedily.
texts.ESV:
Do not hide your face from me
    in the day of my distress!
Incline your ear to me;
    answer me speedily in the day when I call!

texts.NIV84: For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.
texts.KJV: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
texts.NASB95:
For my days have been consumed in smoke,
And my bones have been scorched like a hearth.
texts.NKJV:
For my days are consumed like smoke,
And my bones are burned like a hearth.
texts.DRB: For my days are vanished like smoke: and my bones are grown dry like fuel for the fire.
texts.ESV:
For my days pass away like smoke,
    and my bones burn like a furnace.

texts.NIV84: My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.
texts.KJV: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
texts.NASB95:
My heart has been smitten like grass and has withered away,
Indeed, I forget to eat my bread.
texts.NKJV:
My heart is stricken and withered like grass,
So that I forget to eat my bread.
texts.DRB: I am smitten as grass, and my heart is withered: because I forgot to eat my bread.
texts.ESV:
My heart is struck down like grass and has withered;
    I forget to eat my bread.

texts.NIV84: Because of my loud groaning I am reduced to skin and bones.
texts.KJV: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
texts.NASB95:
Because of the loudness of my groaning
My bones cling to my flesh.
texts.NKJV:
Because of the sound of my groaning
My bones cling to my skin.
texts.DRB: Through the voice of my groaning, my bone hath cleaved to my flesh.
texts.ESV:
Because of my loud groaning
    my bones cling to my flesh.

texts.NIV84: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
texts.KJV: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
texts.NASB95:
I resemble a pelican of the wilderness;
I have become like an owl of the waste places.
texts.NKJV:
I am like a pelican of the wilderness;
I am like an owl of the desert.
texts.DRB: I am become like to a pelican of the wilderness: I am like a night raven in the house.
texts.ESV:
I am like a desert owl of the wilderness,
    like an owl of the waste places;

texts.NIV84: I lie awake; I have become like a bird alone on a roof.
texts.KJV: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
texts.NASB95:
I lie awake,
I have become like a lonely bird on a housetop.
texts.NKJV:
I lie awake,
And am like a sparrow alone on the housetop.
texts.DRB: I have watched, and am become as a sparrow all alone on the housetop.
texts.ESV:
I lie awake;
    I am like a lonely sparrow on the housetop.

texts.NIV84: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.
texts.KJV: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
texts.NASB95:
My enemies have reproached me all day long;
Those who deride me have used my name as a curse.
texts.NKJV:
My enemies reproach me all day long;
Those who deride me swear an oath against me.
texts.DRB: All the day long my enemies reproached me: and they that praised me did swear against me.
texts.ESV:
All the day my enemies taunt me;
    those who deride me use my name for a curse.

texts.NIV84: For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears
texts.KJV: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping.
texts.NASB95:
For I have eaten ashes like bread
And mingled my drink with weeping
texts.NKJV:
For I have eaten ashes like bread,
And mingled my drink with weeping,
texts.DRB: For I did eat ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping.
texts.ESV:
For I eat ashes like bread
    and mingle tears with my drink,

texts.NIV84: because of your great wrath, for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.
texts.KJV: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
texts.NASB95:
Because of Your indignation and Your wrath,
For You have lifted me up and cast me away.
texts.NKJV:
Because of Your indignation and Your wrath;
For You have lifted me up and cast me away.
texts.DRB: Because of thy anger and indignation: for having lifted me up thou hast thrown me down.
texts.ESV:
because of your indignation and anger;
    for you have taken me up and thrown me down.

texts.NIV84: My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.
texts.KJV: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
texts.NASB95:
My days are like a lengthened shadow,
And I wither away like grass.
texts.NKJV:
My days are like a shadow that lengthens,
And I wither away like grass.
texts.DRB: My days have declined like a shadow, and I am withered like grass.
texts.ESV:
My days are like an evening shadow;
    I wither away like grass.

texts.NIV84: But you, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations.
texts.KJV: But thou, O Lord, shall endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
texts.NASB95:
But You, O Lord, abide forever,
And Your name to all generations.
texts.NKJV:
But You, O Lord, shall endure forever,
And the remembrance of Your name to all generations.
texts.DRB: But thou, O Lord, endurest for ever: and thy memorial to all generations.
texts.ESV:
But you, O Lord, are enthroned forever;
    you are remembered throughout all generations.

texts.NIV84: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.
texts.KJV: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
texts.DRB: Thou shalt arise and have mercy on Sion: for it is time to have mercy on it, for the time is come.

texts.NIV84: For her stones are dear to your servants; her very dust moves them to pity.
texts.KJV: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
texts.NASB95:
Surely Your servants find pleasure in her stones
And feel pity for her dust.
texts.NKJV:
For Your servants take pleasure in her stones,
And show favor to her dust.
texts.DRB: For the stones thereof have pleased thy servants: and they shall have pity on the earth thereof.
texts.ESV:
For your servants hold her stones dear
    and have pity on her dust.

texts.NIV84: The nations will fear the name of the LORD, all the kings of the earth will revere your glory.
texts.KJV: So the heathen shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
texts.NASB95:
So the nations will fear the name of the Lord
And all the kings of the earth Your glory.
texts.NKJV:
So the nations shall fear the name of the Lord,
And all the kings of the earth Your glory.
texts.DRB: And the Gentiles shall fear thy name, O Lord, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
texts.ESV:
Nations will fear the name of the Lord,
    and all the kings of the earth will fear your glory.

texts.NIV84: For the LORD will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.
texts.KJV: When the Lord shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
texts.NASB95:
For the Lord has built up Zion;
He has appeared in His glory.
texts.NKJV:
For the Lord shall build up Zion;
He shall appear in His glory.
texts.DRB: For the Lord hath built up Sion: and he shall be seen in his glory.
texts.ESV:
For the Lord builds up Zion;
    he appears in his glory;

texts.NIV84: He will respond to the prayer of the destitute; he will not despise their plea.
texts.KJV: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
texts.NASB95:
He has regarded the prayer of the destitute
And has not despised their prayer.
texts.NKJV:
He shall regard the prayer of the destitute,
And shall not despise their prayer.
texts.DRB: He hath had regard to the prayer of the humble: and he hath not despised their petition.
texts.ESV:
he regards the prayer of the destitute
    and does not despise their prayer.

texts.NIV84: Let this be written for a future generation, that a people not yet created may praise the LORD:
texts.KJV: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the Lord.
texts.NASB95:
This will be written for the generation to come,
That a people yet to be created may praise the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
This will be written for the generation to come,
That a people yet to be created may praise the Lord.
texts.DRB: Let these things be written unto another generation: and the people that shall be created shall praise the Lord:
texts.ESV:
Let this be recorded for a generation to come,
    so that a people yet to be created may praise the Lord:

texts.NIV84: "The LORD looked down from his sanctuary on high, from heaven he viewed the earth,
texts.KJV: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;
texts.NASB95:
For He looked down from His holy height;
From heaven the Lord gazed upon the earth,
texts.NKJV:
For He looked down from the height of His sanctuary;
From heaven the Lord viewed the earth,
texts.DRB: Because he hath looked forth from his high sanctuary: from heaven the Lord hath looked upon the earth.
texts.ESV:
that he looked down from his holy height;
    from heaven the Lord looked at the earth,

texts.NIV84: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death."
texts.KJV: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
texts.NASB95:
To hear the groaning of the prisoner,
To set free those who were doomed to death,
texts.NKJV:
To hear the groaning of the prisoner,
To release those appointed to death,
texts.DRB: That he might hear the groans of them that are in fetters: that he might release the children of the slain:
texts.ESV:
to hear the groans of the prisoners,
    to set free those who were doomed to die,

texts.NIV84: So the name of the LORD will be declared in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem
texts.KJV: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
texts.NASB95:
That men may tell of the name of the Lord in Zion
And His praise in Jerusalem,
texts.NKJV:
To declare the name of the Lord in Zion,
And His praise in Jerusalem,
texts.DRB: That they may declare the name of the Lord in Sion: and his praise in Jerusalem;
texts.ESV:
that they may declare in Zion the name of the Lord,
    and in Jerusalem his praise,

texts.NIV84: when the peoples and the kingdoms assemble to worship the LORD.
texts.KJV: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
texts.NASB95:
When the peoples are gathered together,
And the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
When the peoples are gathered together,
And the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
texts.DRB: When the people assemble together, and kings, to serve the Lord.
texts.ESV:
when peoples gather together,
    and kingdoms, to worship the Lord.

texts.NIV84: In the course of my life he broke my strength; he cut short my days.
texts.KJV: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
texts.NASB95:
He has weakened my strength in the way;
He has shortened my days.
texts.NKJV:
He weakened my strength in the way;
He shortened my days.
texts.DRB: He answered him in the way of his strength: Declare unto me the fewness of my days.
texts.ESV:
He has broken my strength in midcourse;
    he has shortened my days.

texts.NIV84: So I said: "Do not take me away, O my God, in the midst of my days; your years go on through all generations.
texts.KJV: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
texts.NASB95:
I say, “O my God, do not take me away in the midst of my days,
Your years are throughout all generations.
texts.DRB: Call me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are unto generation and generation.
texts.ESV:
“O my God,” I say, “take me not away
    in the midst of my days—
you whose years endure
    throughout all generations!”

texts.NIV84: In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
texts.KJV: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
texts.NASB95:
“Of old You founded the earth,
And the heavens are the work of Your hands.
texts.NKJV:
Of old You laid the foundation of the earth,
And the heavens are the work of Your hands.
texts.DRB: In the beginning, O Lord, thou foundedst the earth: end the heavens are the works of thy hands.
texts.ESV:
Of old you laid the foundation of the earth,
    and the heavens are the work of your hands.

texts.NIV84: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them and they will be discarded.
texts.KJV: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
texts.DRB: They shall perish but thou remainest: and all of them shall grow old like a garment: And as a vesture thou shalt change them, and they shall be changed.

texts.NIV84: But you remain the same, and your years will never end.
texts.KJV: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
texts.NASB95:
“But You are the same,
And Your years will not come to an end.
texts.NKJV:
But You are the same,
And Your years will have no end.
texts.DRB: But thou art always the selfsame, and thy years shall not fail.
texts.ESV: but you are the same, and your years have no end.

texts.NIV84: The children of your servants will live in your presence; their descendants will be established before you."
texts.KJV: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
texts.NASB95:
“The children of Your servants will continue,
And their descendants will be established before You.”
texts.NKJV:
The children of Your servants will continue,
And their descendants will be established before You.”
texts.DRB: The children of thy servants shall continue: and their seed shall be directed for ever.
texts.ESV:
The children of your servants shall dwell secure;
    their offspring shall be established before you.

blocks.title: A Prayer for Help against Enemies

texts.NIV84: O God, whom I praise, do not remain silent,
texts.KJV: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
texts.NASB95:
O God of my praise,
Do not be silent!
texts.NKJV:
Do not keep silent,
O God of my praise!
texts.DRB: Unto the end, a psalm for David.
texts.ESV: Be not silent, O God of my praise!

texts.NIV84: for wicked and deceitful men have opened their mouths against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.
texts.KJV: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
texts.NASB95:
For they have opened the wicked and deceitful mouth against me;
They have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
texts.DRB: O God, be not thou silent in thy praise: for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful man is opened against me.
texts.ESV:
For wicked and deceitful mouths are opened against me,
    speaking against me with lying tongues.

texts.NIV84: With words of hatred they surround me; they attack me without cause.
texts.KJV: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
texts.NASB95:
They have also surrounded me with words of hatred,
And fought against me without cause.
texts.NKJV:
They have also surrounded me with words of hatred,
And fought against me without a cause.
texts.DRB: They have spoken against with deceitful tongues; and they have compassed me about with words of hatred; and have fought against me without cause.
texts.ESV:
They encircle me with words of hate,
    and attack me without cause.

texts.NIV84: In return for my friendship they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
texts.KJV: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
texts.NASB95:
In return for my love they act as my accusers;
But I am in prayer.
texts.NKJV:
In return for my love they are my accusers,
But I give myself to prayer.
texts.DRB: Instead of making me a return of love, they detracted me: but I gave myself to prayer.
texts.ESV:
In return for my love they accuse me,
    but I give myself to prayer.

texts.NIV84: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my friendship.
texts.KJV: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
texts.NASB95:
Thus they have repaid me evil for good
And hatred for my love.
texts.NKJV:
Thus they have rewarded me evil for good,
And hatred for my love.
texts.DRB: And they repaid me evil for good: and hatred for my love.
texts.ESV:
So they reward me evil for good,
    and hatred for my love.

texts.NIV84: Appoint an evil man to oppose him; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
texts.KJV: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
texts.NASB95:
Appoint a wicked man over him,
And let an accuser stand at his right hand.
texts.NKJV:
Set a wicked man over him,
And let an accuser stand at his right hand.
texts.DRB: Set thou the sinner over him: and may the devil stand at his right hand.
texts.ESV:
Appoint a wicked man against him;
    let an accuser stand at his right hand.

texts.NIV84: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayers condemn him.
texts.KJV: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
texts.NASB95:
When he is judged, let him come forth guilty,
And let his prayer become sin.
texts.NKJV:
When he is judged, let him be found guilty,
And let his prayer become sin.
texts.DRB: When he is judged, may he go out condemned; and may his prayer be turned to sin.
texts.ESV:
When he is tried, let him come forth guilty;
    let his prayer be counted as sin!

texts.NIV84: May his days be few; may another take his place of leadership.
texts.KJV: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
texts.NASB95:
Let his days be few;
Let another take his office.
texts.NKJV:
Let his days be few,
And let another take his office.
texts.DRB: May his days be few: and his bishopric let another take.
texts.ESV:
May his days be few;
    may another take his office!

texts.NIV84: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
texts.KJV: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
texts.NASB95:
Let his children be fatherless
And his wife a widow.
texts.NKJV:
Let his children be fatherless,
And his wife a widow.
texts.DRB: May his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
texts.ESV:
May his children be fatherless
    and his wife a widow!

texts.NIV84: May his children be wandering beggars; may they be driven from their ruined homes.
texts.KJV: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
texts.NASB95:
Let his children wander about and beg;
And let them seek sustenance far from their ruined homes.
texts.NKJV:
Let his children continually be vagabonds, and beg;
Let them seek their bread also from their desolate places.
texts.DRB: Let his children be carried about vagabonds, and beg; and let them be cast out of their dwellings.
texts.ESV:
May his children wander about and beg,
    seeking food far from the ruins they inhabit!

texts.NIV84: May a creditor seize all he has; may strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
texts.KJV: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
texts.NASB95:
Let the creditor seize all that he has,
And let strangers plunder the product of his labor.
texts.NKJV:
Let the creditor seize all that he has,
And let strangers plunder his labor.
texts.DRB: May the userer search all his substance: and let strangers plunder his labours.
texts.ESV:
May the creditor seize all that he has;
    may strangers plunder the fruits of his toil!

texts.NIV84: May no one extend kindness to him or take pity on his fatherless children.
texts.KJV: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
texts.NASB95:
Let there be none to extend lovingkindness to him,
Nor any to be gracious to his fatherless children.
texts.NKJV:
Let there be none to extend mercy to him,
Nor let there be any to favor his fatherless children.
texts.DRB: May there be none to help him: nor none to pity his fatherless offspring.
texts.ESV:
Let there be none to extend kindness to him,
    nor any to pity his fatherless children!

texts.NIV84: May his descendants be cut off, their names blotted out from the next generation.
texts.KJV: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
texts.NASB95:
Let his posterity be cut off;
In a following generation let their name be blotted out.
texts.NKJV:
Let his posterity be cut off,
And in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
texts.DRB: May his posterity be cut off; in one generation may his name be blotted out.
texts.ESV:
May his posterity be cut off;
    may his name be blotted out in the second generation!

texts.NIV84: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD; may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
texts.KJV: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
texts.NASB95:
Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord,
And do not let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
texts.NKJV:
Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord,
And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
texts.DRB: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered in the sight of the Lord: and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
texts.ESV:
May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord,
    and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out!

texts.NIV84: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
texts.KJV: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
texts.NASB95:
Let them be before the Lord continually,
That He may cut off their memory from the earth;
texts.NKJV:
Let them be continually before the Lord,
That He may cut off the memory of them from the earth;
texts.DRB: May they be before the lord continually, and let the memory of them perish from the earth:
texts.ESV:
Let them be before the Lord continually,
    that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth!

texts.NIV84: For he never thought of doing a kindness, but hounded to death the poor and the needy and the brokenhearted.
texts.KJV: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
texts.NASB95:
Because he did not remember to show lovingkindness,
But persecuted the afflicted and needy man,
And the despondent in heart, to put them to death.
texts.NKJV:
Because he did not remember to show mercy,
