But persecuted the poor and needy man,
That he might even slay the broken in heart.
texts.DRB: because he remembered not to show mercy,
texts.ESV:
For he did not remember to show kindness,
    but pursued the poor and needy
    and the brokenhearted, to put them to death.

texts.NIV84: He loved to pronounce a curse- may it come on him; he found no pleasure in blessing- may it be far from him.
texts.KJV: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
texts.NASB95:
He also loved cursing, so it came to him;
And he did not delight in blessing, so it was far from him.
texts.NKJV:
As he loved cursing, so let it come to him;
As he did not delight in blessing, so let it be far from him.
texts.DRB: But persecuted the poor man and the beggar; and the broken in heart, to put him to death.
texts.ESV:
He loved to curse; let curses come upon him!
    He did not delight in blessing; may it be far from him!

texts.NIV84: He wore cursing as his garment; it entered into his body like water, into his bones like oil.
texts.KJV: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
texts.NASB95:
But he clothed himself with cursing as with his garment,
And it entered into his body like water
And like oil into his bones.
texts.NKJV:
As he clothed himself with cursing as with his garment,
So let it enter his body like water,
And like oil into his bones.
texts.DRB: And he loved cursing, and it shall come unto him: and he would not have blessing, and it shall be far from him. And he put on cursing, like a garment: and it went in like water into his entrails, and like oil in his bones.

texts.NIV84: May it be like a cloak wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
texts.KJV: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
texts.NASB95:
Let it be to him as a garment with which he covers himself,
And for a belt with which he constantly girds himself.
texts.NKJV:
Let it be to him like the garment which covers him,
And for a belt with which he girds himself continually.
texts.DRB: May it be unto him like a garment which covereth him; and like a girdle with which he is girded continually.
texts.ESV:
May it be like a garment that he wraps around him,
    like a belt that he puts on every day!

texts.NIV84: May this be the LORD's payment to my accusers, to those who speak evil of me.
texts.KJV: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
texts.NASB95:
Let this be the reward of my accusers from the Lord,
And of those who speak evil against my soul.
texts.NKJV:
Let this be the Lord’s reward to my accusers,
And to those who speak evil against my person.
texts.DRB: This is the work of them who detract me before the Lord; and who speak evils against my soul.
texts.ESV:
May this be the reward of my accusers from the Lord,
    of those who speak evil against my life!

texts.NIV84: But you, O Sovereign LORD, deal well with me for your name's sake; out of the goodness of your love, deliver me.
texts.KJV: But do thou for me, O God the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
texts.NASB95:
But You, O God, the Lord, deal kindly with me for Your name’s sake;
Because Your lovingkindness is good, deliver me;
texts.DRB: But thou, O Lord, do with for thy names sake: because thy mercy is sweet. Do thou deliver me.

texts.NIV84: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
texts.KJV: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
texts.NASB95:
For I am afflicted and needy,
And my heart is wounded within me.
texts.NKJV:
For I am poor and needy,
And my heart is wounded within me.
texts.DRB: for I am poor and needy, and my heart is troubled within me.
texts.ESV:
For I am poor and needy,
    and my heart is stricken within me.

texts.NIV84: I fade away like an evening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
texts.KJV: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
texts.NASB95:
I am passing like a shadow when it lengthens;
I am shaken off like the locust.
texts.NKJV:
I am gone like a shadow when it lengthens;
I am shaken off like a locust.
texts.DRB: I am taken away like the shadow when it declineth: and I am shaken off as locusts.
texts.ESV:
I am gone like a shadow at evening;
    I am shaken off like a locust.

texts.NIV84: My knees give way from fasting; my body is thin and gaunt.
texts.KJV: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
texts.NASB95:
My knees are weak from fasting,
And my flesh has grown lean, without fatness.
texts.NKJV:
My knees are weak through fasting,
And my flesh is feeble from lack of fatness.
texts.DRB: My knees are weakened through fasting: and my flesh is changed for oil.
texts.ESV:
My knees are weak through fasting;
    my body has become gaunt, with no fat.

texts.NIV84: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
texts.KJV: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
texts.NASB95:
I also have become a reproach to them;
When they see me, they wag their head.
texts.NKJV:
I also have become a reproach to them;
When they look at me, they shake their heads.
texts.DRB: And I am become a reproach to them: they saw me and they shaked their heads,
texts.ESV:
I am an object of scorn to my accusers;
    when they see me, they wag their heads.

texts.NIV84: Help me, O LORD my God; save me in accordance with your love.
texts.KJV: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
texts.NASB95:
Help me, O Lord my God;
Save me according to Your lovingkindness.
texts.NKJV:
Help me, O Lord my God!
Oh, save me according to Your mercy,
texts.DRB: Help me, O Lord my God; save me according to thy mercy.
texts.ESV:
Help me, O Lord my God!
    Save me according to your steadfast love!

texts.NIV84: Let them know that it is your hand, that you, O LORD, have done it.
texts.KJV: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, Lord, hast done it.
texts.NASB95:
And let them know that this is Your hand;
You, Lord, have done it.
texts.NKJV:
That they may know that this is Your hand—
That You, Lord, have done it!
texts.DRB: And let them know that this is thy hand: and that thou, O Lord, hast done it.
texts.ESV:
Let them know that this is your hand;
    you, O Lord, have done it!

texts.NIV84: They may curse, but you will bless; when they attack they will be put to shame, but your servant will rejoice.
texts.KJV: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
texts.DRB: They will curse and thou will bless: let them that rise up against me be confounded: but thy servant shall rejoice.
texts.ESV:
Let them curse, but you will bless!
    They arise and are put to shame, but your servant will be glad!

texts.NIV84: My accusers will be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.
texts.KJV: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
texts.NASB95:
Let my accusers be clothed with dishonor,
And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
texts.NKJV:
Let my accusers be clothed with shame,
And let them cover themselves with their own disgrace as with a mantle.
texts.DRB: Let them that detract me be clothed with shame: and let them be covered with the their confusion as with a double cloak.
texts.ESV:
May my accusers be clothed with dishonor;
    may they be wrapped in their own shame as in a cloak!

texts.NIV84: With my mouth I will greatly extol the LORD; in the great throng I will praise him.
texts.KJV: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
texts.NASB95:
With my mouth I will give thanks abundantly to the Lord;
And in the midst of many I will praise Him.
texts.NKJV:
I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth;
Yes, I will praise Him among the multitude.
texts.DRB: I will give great thanks to the Lord with my mouth: and in the midst of many I will praise him.
texts.ESV:
With my mouth I will give great thanks to the Lord;
    I will praise him in the midst of the throng.

texts.NIV84: For he stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save his life from those who condemn him.
texts.KJV: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
texts.NASB95:
For He stands at the right hand of the needy,
To save him from those who judge his soul.
texts.NKJV:
For He shall stand at the right hand of the poor,
To save him from those who condemn him.
texts.DRB: Because he hath stood at the right hand of the poor, to save my soul from persecutors
texts.ESV:
For he stands at the right hand of the needy one,
    to save him from those who condemn his soul to death.

texts.NIV84: I lift up my eyes to you, to you whose throne is in heaven.
texts.KJV: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
texts.NASB95:
To You I lift up my eyes,
O You who are enthroned in the heavens!
texts.NKJV:
Unto You I lift up my eyes,
O You who dwell in the heavens.
texts.DRB: To thee have I lifted up my eyes, who dwellest in heaven.
texts.ESV:
To you I lift up my eyes,
    O you who are enthroned in the heavens!

texts.NIV84: As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, till he shows us his mercy.
texts.KJV: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
texts.NASB95:
Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master,
As the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,
So our eyes look to the Lord our God,
Until He is gracious to us.
texts.NKJV:
Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters,
As the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,
So our eyes look to the Lord our God,
Until He has mercy on us.
texts.DRB: Behold as the eyes of the servants are on the hands of their masters, As the eyes of the handmaid are on the hands of her mistress: so are our eyes unto the Lord our God, until he have mercy on us.
texts.ESV:
Behold, as the eyes of servants
    look to the hand of their master,
as the eyes of a maidservant
    to the hand of her mistress,
so our eyes look to the Lord our God,
    till he has mercy upon us.

texts.NIV84: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
texts.KJV: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
texts.NASB95:
Be gracious to us, O Lord, be gracious to us,
For we are greatly filled with contempt.
texts.NKJV:
Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us!
For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
texts.DRB: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: for we are greatly filled with contempt.
texts.ESV:
Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us,
    for we have had more than enough of contempt.

texts.NIV84: We have endured much ridicule from the proud, much contempt from the arrogant.
texts.KJV: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
texts.NASB95:
Our soul is greatly filled
With the scoffing of those who are at ease,
And with the contempt of the proud.
texts.NKJV:
Our soul is exceedingly filled
With the scorn of those who are at ease,
With the contempt of the proud.
texts.DRB: For our soul is greatly filled: we are a reproach to the rich, and contempt to the proud.
texts.ESV:
Our soul has had more than enough
    of the scorn of those who are at ease,
    of the contempt of the proud.

blocks.title: Prayer for Deliverance from Evil Men

texts.NIV84: Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men; protect me from men of violence,
texts.KJV: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
texts.NASB95:
Rescue me, O Lord, from evil men;
Preserve me from violent men
texts.NKJV:
Deliver me, O Lord, from evil men;
Preserve me from violent men,
texts.DRB: Unto the end, a psalm for David. Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: rescue me from the unjust man.
texts.ESV:
Deliver me, O Lord, from evil men;
    preserve me from violent men,

texts.NIV84: who devise evil plans in their hearts and stir up war every day.
texts.KJV: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
texts.NASB95:
Who devise evil things in their hearts;
They continually stir up wars.
texts.NKJV:
Who plan evil things in their hearts;
They continually gather together for war.
texts.DRB: Who have devised iniquities in their hearts: all the day long they designed battles.
texts.ESV:
who plan evil things in their heart
    and stir up wars continually.

texts.NIV84: They make their tongues as sharp as a serpent's; the poison of vipers is on their lips. Selah
texts.KJV: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
texts.NASB95:
They sharpen their tongues as a serpent;
Poison of a viper is under their lips. Selah.
texts.NKJV:
They sharpen their tongues like a serpent;
The poison of asps is under their lips. Selah
texts.DRB: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent: the venom of saps is under their lips.
texts.ESV:
They make their tongue sharp as a serpent's,
    and under their lips is the venom of asps. Selah

texts.NIV84: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; protect me from men of violence who plan to trip my feet.
texts.KJV: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
texts.DRB: Keep me, O Lord, from the hand of the wicked: and from unjust men deliver me. Who have proposed to supplant my steps.

texts.NIV84: Proud men have hidden a snare for me; they have spread out the cords of their net and have set traps for me along my path. Selah
texts.KJV: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
texts.DRB: the proud have hidden a net for me. And they have stretched out cords for a snare: they have laid for me a stumblingblock by the wayside.

texts.NIV84: O LORD, I say to you, "You are my God." Hear, O LORD, my cry for mercy.
texts.KJV: I said unto the Lord, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.
texts.NASB95:
I said to the Lord, “You are my God;
Give ear, O Lord, to the voice of my supplications.
texts.NKJV:
I said to the Lord: “You are my God;
Hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.
texts.DRB: I said to the Lord: Thou art my God: hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication.
texts.ESV:
I say to the Lord, You are my God;
    give ear to the voice of my pleas for mercy, O Lord!

texts.NIV84: O Sovereign LORD, my strong deliverer, who shields my head in the day of battle-
texts.KJV: O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
texts.NASB95:
“O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation,
You have covered my head in the day of battle.
texts.NKJV:
O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation,
You have covered my head in the day of battle.
texts.DRB: O Lord, Lord, the strength of my salvation: thou hast overshadowed my head in the day of battle.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, my Lord, the strength of my salvation,
    you have covered my head in the day of battle.

texts.NIV84: do not grant the wicked their desires, O LORD; do not let their plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah
texts.KJV: Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
texts.NASB95:
“Do not grant, O Lord, the desires of the wicked;
Do not promote his evil device, that they not be exalted. Selah.
texts.DRB: Give me not up, O Lord, from my desire to the wicked: they have plotted against me; do not thou forsake me, lest they should triumph.
texts.ESV:
Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked;
    do not further their evil plot, or they will be exalted! Selah

texts.NIV84: Let the heads of those who surround me be covered with the trouble their lips have caused.
texts.KJV: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
texts.NASB95:
“As for the head of those who surround me,
May the mischief of their lips cover them.
texts.NKJV:
“As for the head of those who surround me,
Let the evil of their lips cover them;
texts.DRB: The head of them compassing me about: the labour of their lips shall overwhelm them.
texts.ESV:
As for the head of those who surround me,
    let the mischief of their lips overwhelm them!

texts.NIV84: Let burning coals fall upon them; may they be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, never to rise.
texts.KJV: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
texts.DRB: Burning coals shall fall upon them; thou wilt cast them down into the fire: in miseries they shall not be able to stand.
texts.ESV:
Let burning coals fall upon them!
    Let them be cast into fire,
    into miry pits, no more to rise!

texts.NIV84: Let slanderers not be established in the land; may disaster hunt down men of violence.
texts.KJV: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
texts.NASB95:
“May a slanderer not be established in the earth;
May evil hunt the violent man speedily.”
texts.NKJV:
Let not a slanderer be established in the earth;
Let evil hunt the violent man to overthrow him.”
texts.DRB: A man full of tongue shall not be established in the earth: evil shall catch the unjust man unto destruction.
texts.ESV:
Let not the slanderer be established in the land;
    let evil hunt down the violent man speedily!

texts.NIV84: I know that the LORD secures justice for the poor and upholds the cause of the needy.
texts.KJV: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
texts.NASB95:
I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted
And justice for the poor.
texts.NKJV:
I know that the Lord will maintain
The cause of the afflicted,
And justice for the poor.
texts.DRB: I know that the Lord will do justice to the needy, and will revenge the poor.
texts.ESV:
I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted,
    and will execute justice for the needy.

texts.NIV84: Surely the righteous will praise your name and the upright will live before you.
texts.KJV: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
texts.NASB95:
Surely the righteous will give thanks to Your name;
The upright will dwell in Your presence.
texts.NKJV:
Surely the righteous shall give thanks to Your name;
The upright shall dwell in Your presence.
texts.DRB: But as for the just, they shall give glory to thy name: and the upright shall dwell with thy countenance.
texts.ESV:
Surely the righteous shall give thanks to your name;
    the upright shall dwell in your presence.

texts.NIV84: O LORD, I call to you; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to you.
texts.KJV: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, I call upon You; hasten to me!
Give ear to my voice when I call to You!
texts.DRB: I have cried to the, O Lord, hear me: hearken to my voice, when I cry to thee.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, I call upon you; hasten to me!
    Give ear to my voice when I call to you!

texts.NIV84: May my prayer be set before you like incense; may the lifting up of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.
texts.KJV: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
texts.NASB95:
May my prayer be counted as incense before You;
The lifting up of my hands as the evening offering.
texts.NKJV:
Let my prayer be set before You as incense,
The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
texts.DRB: Let my prayer be directed as incense in thy sight; the lifting up of my hands, as evening sacrifice.
texts.ESV:
Let my prayer be counted as incense before you,
    and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice!

texts.NIV84: Set a guard over my mouth, O LORD; keep watch over the door of my lips.
texts.KJV: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
texts.NASB95:
Set a guard, O Lord, over my mouth;
Keep watch over the door of my lips.
texts.NKJV:
Set a guard, O Lord, over my mouth;
Keep watch over the door of my lips.
texts.DRB: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth: and a door round about my lips.
texts.ESV:
Set a guard, O Lord, over my mouth;
    keep watch over the door of my lips!

texts.NIV84: Let not my heart be drawn to what is evil, to take part in wicked deeds with men who are evildoers; let me not eat of their delicacies.
texts.KJV: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
texts.NASB95:
Do not incline my heart to any evil thing,
To practice deeds of wickedness
With men who do iniquity;
And do not let me eat of their delicacies.
texts.NKJV:
Do not incline my heart to any evil thing,
To practice wicked works
With men who work iniquity;
And do not let me eat of their delicacies.
texts.DRB: Incline not my heart to evil words; to make excuses in sins. With men that work iniquity: and I will not communicate with the choicest of them.
texts.ESV:
Do not let my heart incline to any evil,
    to busy myself with wicked deeds
in company with men who work iniquity,
    and let me not eat of their delicacies!

texts.NIV84: Let a righteous man strike me-it is a kindness; let him rebuke me-it is oil on my head. My head will not refuse it. Yet my prayer is ever against the deeds of evildoers;
texts.KJV: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
texts.DRB: The just shall correct me in mercy, and shall reprove me: but let not the oil of the sinner fatten my head. For my prayer also shall still be against the things with which they are well pleased:

texts.NIV84: their rulers will be thrown down from the cliffs, and the wicked will learn that my words were well spoken.
texts.KJV: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
texts.NASB95:
Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock,
And they hear my words, for they are pleasant.
texts.NKJV:
Their judges are overthrown by the sides of the cliff,
And they hear my words, for they are sweet.
texts.DRB: their judges falling upon the rock have been swallowed up. They shall hear my words, for they have prevailed:
texts.ESV:
When their judges are thrown over the cliff,
    then they shall hear my words, for they are pleasant.

texts.NIV84: They will say, "As one plows and breaks up the earth, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave. "
texts.KJV: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
texts.NASB95:
As when one plows and breaks open the earth,
Our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
texts.NKJV:
Our bones are scattered at the mouth of the grave,
As when one plows and breaks up the earth.
texts.DRB: as when the thickness of the earth is broken up upon the ground: Our bones are scattered by the side of hell.
texts.ESV:
As when one plows and breaks up the earth,
    so shall our bones be scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

texts.NIV84: But my eyes are fixed on you, O Sovereign LORD; in you I take refuge-do not give me over to death.
texts.KJV: But mine eyes are unto thee, O God the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
texts.NASB95:
For my eyes are toward You, O God, the Lord;
In You I take refuge; do not leave me defenseless.
texts.DRB: But o to thee, O Lord, Lord, are my eyes: in thee have I put my trust, take not away my soul.
texts.ESV:
But my eyes are toward you, O God, my Lord;
    in you I seek refuge; leave me not defenseless!

texts.NIV84: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, from the traps set by evildoers.
texts.KJV: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
texts.NASB95:
Keep me from the jaws of the trap which they have set for me,
And from the snares of those who do iniquity.
texts.NKJV:
Keep me from the snares they have laid for me,
And from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
texts.DRB: Keep me from the snare, which they have laid for me, and from the stumblingblocks of them that work iniquity.
texts.ESV:
Keep me from the trap that they have laid for me
    and from the snares of evildoers!

texts.NIV84: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
texts.KJV: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
texts.NASB95:
Let the wicked fall into their own nets,
While I pass by safely.
texts.NKJV:
Let the wicked fall into their own nets,
While I escape safely.
texts.DRB: The wicked shall fall in his net: I am alone until I pass.
texts.ESV:
Let the wicked fall into their own nets,
    while I pass by safely.

blocks.title: A Plea for Relief from Persecutors

texts.NIV84: I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift up my voice to the LORD for mercy.
texts.KJV: I cried unto the Lord with my voice; with my voice unto the Lord did I make my supplication.
texts.NASB95:
I cry aloud with my voice to the Lord;
I make supplication with my voice to the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
I cry out to the Lord with my voice;
With my voice to the Lord I make my supplication.
texts.DRB: Of understanding for David. A prayer when he was in the cave. [1 Kings 24]. I cried to the Lord with my voice: with my voice I made supplication to the Lord.
texts.ESV:
With my voice I cry out to the Lord;
    with my voice I plead for mercy to the Lord.

texts.NIV84: I pour out my complaint before him; before him I tell my trouble.
texts.KJV: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
texts.NASB95:
I pour out my complaint before Him;
I declare my trouble before Him.
texts.NKJV:
I pour out my complaint before Him;
I declare before Him my trouble.
texts.DRB: In his sight I pour out my prayer, and before him I declare my trouble:
texts.ESV:
I pour out my complaint before him;
    I tell my trouble before him.

texts.NIV84: When my spirit grows faint within me, it is you who know my way. In the path where I walk men have hidden a snare for me.
texts.KJV: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
texts.NASB95:
When my spirit was overwhelmed within me,
You knew my path.
In the way where I walk
They have hidden a trap for me.
texts.NKJV:
When my spirit was overwhelmed within me,
Then You knew my path.
In the way in which I walk
They have secretly set a snare for me.
texts.DRB: When my spirit failed me, then thou newest my paths.
texts.ESV:
When my spirit faints within me,
    you know my way!
In the path where I walk
    they have hidden a trap for me.

texts.NIV84: Look to my right and see; no one is concerned for me. I have no refuge; no one cares for my life.
texts.KJV: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
texts.DRB: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, and there was no one that would know me. Flight hath failed me: and there is no one that hath regard to my soul.

texts.NIV84: I cry to you, O LORD; I say, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."
texts.KJV: I cried unto thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
texts.NKJV:
I cried out to You, O Lord:
I said, “You are my refuge,
My portion in the land of the living.
texts.DRB: I cried to thee, O Lord: I said: Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the living.

texts.NIV84: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need; rescue me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.
texts.KJV: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
texts.NASB95:
“Give heed to my cry,
For I am brought very low;
Deliver me from my persecutors,
For they are too strong for me.
texts.NKJV:
Attend to my cry,
For I am brought very low;
Deliver me from my persecutors,
For they are stronger than I.
texts.DRB: Attend to my supplication: for I am brought very low. Deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
texts.ESV:
Attend to my cry,
    for I am brought very low!
Deliver me from my persecutors,
    for they are too strong for me!

texts.NIV84: Set me free from my prison, that I may praise your name. Then the righteous will gather about me because of your goodness to me.
texts.KJV: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
texts.NASB95:
“Bring my soul out of prison,
So that I may give thanks to Your name;
The righteous will surround me,
For You will deal bountifully with me.”
texts.NKJV:
Bring my soul out of prison,
That I may praise Your name;
The righteous shall surround me,
For You shall deal bountifully with me.”
texts.DRB: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the just wait for me, until thou reward me.
texts.ESV:
Bring me out of prison,
    that I may give thanks to your name!
The righteous will surround me,
    for you will deal bountifully with me.

texts.NIV84: O LORD, hear my prayer, listen to my cry for mercy; in your faithfulness and righteousness come to my relief.
texts.KJV: Hear my prayer, O Lord, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
texts.NASB95:
Hear my prayer, O Lord,
Give ear to my supplications!
Answer me in Your faithfulness, in Your righteousness!
texts.NKJV:
Hear my prayer, O Lord,
Give ear to my supplications!
In Your faithfulness answer me,
And in Your righteousness.
texts.DRB: Hear, O Lord, my prayer: give ear to my supplication in thy truth: hear me in thy justice.

texts.NIV84: Do not bring your servant into judgment, for no one living is righteous before you.
texts.KJV: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
texts.NASB95:
And do not enter into judgment with Your servant,
For in Your sight no man living is righteous.
texts.NKJV:
Do not enter into judgment with Your servant,
For in Your sight no one living is righteous.
texts.DRB: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight no man living shall be justified.
texts.ESV:
Enter not into judgment with your servant,
    for no one living is righteous before you.

texts.NIV84: The enemy pursues me, he crushes me to the ground; he makes me dwell in darkness like those long dead.
texts.KJV: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
texts.DRB: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul: he hath brought down my life to the earth. He hath made me to dwell in darkness as those that have been dead of old:

texts.NIV84: So my spirit grows faint within me; my heart within me is dismayed.
texts.KJV: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
texts.NASB95:
Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me;
My heart is appalled within me.
texts.NKJV:
Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me;
My heart within me is distressed.
texts.DRB: and my spirit is in anguish within me: my heart within me is troubled.
texts.ESV:
Therefore my spirit faints within me;
    my heart within me is appalled.

texts.NIV84: I remember the days of long ago; I meditate on all your works and consider what your hands have done.
texts.KJV: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
texts.DRB: I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all thy works: I meditated upon the works of thy hands.

texts.NIV84: I spread out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like a parched land. Selah
texts.KJV: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
texts.NASB95:
I stretch out my hands to You;
My soul longs for You, as a parched land. Selah.
texts.NKJV:
I spread out my hands to You;
My soul longs for You like a thirsty land. Selah
texts.DRB: I stretched forth my hands to thee: my soul is as earth without water unto thee.
texts.ESV:
I stretch out my hands to you;
    my soul thirsts for you like a parched land. Selah

texts.NIV84: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me or I will be like those who go down to the pit.
texts.KJV: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
texts.NKJV:
Answer me speedily, O Lord;
My spirit fails!
Do not hide Your face from me,
Lest I be like those who go down into the pit.
texts.DRB: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit hath fainted away. Turn not away thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
texts.ESV:
Answer me quickly, O Lord!
    My spirit fails!
Hide not your face from me,
    lest I be like those who go down to the pit.

texts.NIV84: Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love, for I have put my trust in you. Show me the way I should go, for to you I lift up my soul.
texts.KJV: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
texts.NKJV:
Cause me to hear Your lovingkindness in the morning,
For in You do I trust;
Cause me to know the way in which I should walk,
For I lift up my soul to You.
texts.DRB: Cause me to hear thy mercy in the morning; for in thee have I hoped. Make the way known to me, wherein I should walk: for I have lifted up my soul to thee.
texts.ESV:
Let me hear in the morning of your steadfast love,
    for in you I trust.
Make me know the way I should go,
    for to you I lift up my soul.

texts.NIV84: Rescue me from my enemies, O LORD, for I hide myself in you.
texts.KJV: Deliver me, O Lord, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
texts.NASB95:
Deliver me, O Lord, from my enemies;
I take refuge in You.
texts.NKJV:
Deliver me, O Lord, from my enemies;
In You I take shelter.
texts.DRB: Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord, to thee have I fled:
texts.ESV:
Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord!
    I have fled to you for refuge.

texts.NIV84: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God; may your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
texts.KJV: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
texts.NKJV:
Teach me to do Your will,
For You are my God;
Your Spirit is good.
Lead me in the land of uprightness.
texts.DRB: teach me to do thy will, for thou art my God. Thy good spirit shall lead me into the right land:
texts.ESV:
Teach me to do your will,
    for you are my God!
Let your good Spirit lead me
    on level ground!

texts.NIV84: For your name's sake, O LORD, preserve my life; in your righteousness, bring me out of trouble.
texts.KJV: Quicken me, O Lord, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
texts.NASB95:
For the sake of Your name, O Lord, revive me.
In Your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
texts.NKJV:
Revive me, O Lord, for Your name’s sake!
For Your righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.
texts.DRB: for thy name's sake, O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice. Thou wilt bring my soul out of trouble:
texts.ESV:
For your name's sake, O Lord, preserve my life!
    In your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble!

texts.NIV84: In your unfailing love, silence my enemies; destroy all my foes, for I am your servant.
texts.KJV: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
texts.NASB95:
And in Your lovingkindness, cut off my enemies
And destroy all those who afflict my soul,
For I am Your servant.
texts.DRB: and in thy mercy thou wilt destroy my enemies. And thou wilt cut off all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
texts.ESV:
And in your steadfast love you will cut off my enemies,
    and you will destroy all the adversaries of my soul,
    for I am your servant.
